title: Who can apply (ukri.org)
text:
Who is eligible to apply
This opportunity is open to organisations on the standard eligibility list.
It is not open to organisations based overseas.
To apply, you must be:
the project lead (or the fellow, if applying for a fellowship)
based at a UKRI-approved organisation and have their support
resident in the UK when you apply, or will be resident in the UK for the duration of the project
You must also check to make sure you meet all of UKRI’s individual eligibility criteria .
Equality, diversity and inclusion
We are committed to equal opportunity for all funding applicants and encourage applications from a diverse range of researchers.
Who else can be involved
Although businesses are not eligible to be included as project lead (PL) or project co-lead (PcL), there must be at least one industry project partner included within the application (see the ‘What we’re looking for’ section for further information, including private sector leverage requirements).
Demand management
We are not currently limiting application numbers for this funding opportunity, but if we get more applications than we can assess, we may start to limit numbers.
